scope: Offline production Harper input/export plus ML reference inference; no editor ML integration or source edits.
timing_contract: Production includes syntax parsing, cache lookup/linting and diagnostic mapping. Cold cache uses a fresh Checker with process-resident dictionary. First process document may include dictionary initialization. Spell-only configures the curated group with only SpellCheck enabled; uses the identical already-built Documents and dictionary; excludes Document parsing/construction/diagnostic filtering (cold suggestion-cache samples include constructing the configured LintGroup), so it is not an end-to-end latency comparison. Export and serialization are outside timings.

liquid.scope: Conservative scalar/source-geometry guard, not semantic or syntax correctness approval. Unsafe proposals leave document source unchanged. No source file is edited.

gector.scope: Conservative scalar/source-geometry guard, not semantic or syntax correctness approval. Unsafe proposals leave document source unchanged. No source file is edited.

harper.scope: Conservative scalar/source-geometry guard, not semantic or syntax correctness approval. Unsafe proposals leave document source unchanged. No source file is edited.

harper-spelling.scope: Conservative scalar/source-geometry guard, not semantic or syntax correctness approval. Unsafe proposals leave document source unchanged. No source file is edited.

measurement_isolation: No Cargo compilation or test suite ran concurrently with the Harper export or ML inference; one ML worker at a time. Later validation builds are separate.

checks.rust_focused_tests: 3/3 optimized regression tests plus production export passed
checks.required_checks: passed: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --no-fail-fast; cargo test --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
checks.report_html_and_inline_js: HTML parsed; inline JavaScript syntax check passed; no visual QA claim
checks.debug_test_linker_warning: The macOS debug test linker warned about a large __eh_frame section; compilation and all tests passed. No release app performance conclusion is drawn from this warning.

reproduced_export.address_protection_regression: Urls, email addresses and hostnames are protected in the test-only adapter; no such tokens occur in the measured fixtures, so primary inputs are unchanged.
reproduced_export.samples_kept_separate: Timings from the reproduction are not pooled with the original benchmark.

reference_identity: All duplicate ML input strings have identical expected/accepted references.
